cover.title: 5 niche ways to make your site readable by claude and chatgpt

inner.title: one h1, clean h2s
inner.body: airops research cited by vercel found pages with clean heading hierarchy and matching schema earned 2.8x higher ai citation rates. if your page has three h1s and no h2s, a model is reading a pile.

inner.title: answer in line one
inner.body: vercel advises answer-first sections and paragraphs of 2 to 4 sentences. bury the answer under a story and the model quotes the page that didn't.

inner.title: put prices in a table
inner.body: one agency guide says to use html tables for comparison data like plans and features. a pricing grid built from styled divs reads as a mess of words.

inner.title: show the faq
inner.body: the same guide wants visible questions and answers with faqpage schema in the raw html. hide them in a dropdown that loads late and the schema describes text nobody can read.

inner.title: don't trust schema alone
inner.body: vercel found pages with three or more relevant schema types were about 13% more likely to be cited. it also says schema supports visible content but can't fix vague language.
